definitions.explanation: Having to do with or involving many different countries. Used to describe organizations, forces, or groups composed of members from multiple nations.

examples.japanese: {多国籍|たこくせき}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: To work at a multinational corporation.

examples.japanese: {多国籍|たこくせき}⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多国籍|たこくせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、10か{国|こく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}している→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: This team is multinational, with members from ten countries participating.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the fixed expression {多国籍|たこくせき}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ (multinational corporation). Also used in military and political contexts: {多国籍|たこくせき}⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧ (multinational force).

Can function as a noun or a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective to modify other nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多国籍|たこくせき}⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: multinational corporation
- {多国籍|たこくせき}⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧: multinational force
- {多国籍|たこくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: employees of multiple nationalities
- {多国籍|たこくせき}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧: multinational team
